question: What was measured for wf's options on clap (standard-crates plan, phase 4c)?
workload: 2026-10-09: wf's options on clap (standard-crates plan, phase 4c)
method: Transcribed from the cited historical record. Units and precision follow the source.
finding: Reported observations and context: Measured (release builds, the same loop for both binaries, interleaved, 30 spawns per round, 5 rounds, medians; before is the build of the VNC-gate slice): `wf --help` 3.24 ms before and 3.16 ms after; a refused command line (`wf metro status --bogus`) 4.93 and 4.96 ms; a parsed one (`wf metro status --identifier x`) 7.42 and 7.66 ms. Binary 8,149,368 B (gate slice) to 8,176,600 B (forwarder slice) to 8,305,912 B: `clap` costs about 130 KB.
